final: WITH c AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client cl JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - av) AS avg_excess_over_avg FROM s, a WHERE share > av
